SELECT

    em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'max_c' AS max_c,
    em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'min_c' AS min_c,
    -- Individual MKT components
    EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'avg_c' AS float) + 273.15))) AS exp_avg,
    EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'max_c' AS float) + 273.15))) AS exp_max,
    EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'min_c' AS float) + 273.15))) AS exp_min,
    -- Sum and average of exponentials
    (EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'avg_c' AS float) + 273.15))) + 
     EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'max_c' AS float) + 273.15))) + 
     EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'min_c' AS float) + 273.15)))) / 3.0 AS sum_exp_avg,
    LN((EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'avg_c' AS float) + 273.15))) + 
        EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'max_c' AS float) + 273.15))) + 
        EXP(-83144.0 / (8.3144 * (CAST(em.env_metrics::jsonb -> 'temperature' ->> 'min_c' AS float) + 273.15)))) / 3.0) AS ln_sum,
